name: Emmforce Autotech Ltd
title: Emmforce Autotech Ltd - 544166 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue to INR195 crores (auto INR165 crores plus agri INR30 crores) on a single US export order, while automotive utilisation sits at only 50-55%, so supply is idle and the growth case rests on one customer.

utilisation.quote: The current utilization levels remain at about 50% to 55% in automotive and 8% to 10% in agri

capex.quote: a large part of this capex has been executed ahead of the revenue scale up

triggers.label: Auto utilisation 50-55%
triggers.quote: The current utilization levels remain at about 50% to 55% in automotive

triggers.label: FY27 revenue target INR165 cr auto + INR30 cr agri
triggers.quote: we are targeting revenue of approximately INR165 crores from the automotive business and around INR30 crores from the Agri segment

triggers.label: Customer inventory rationalisation ongoing
triggers.quote: the inventory rationalization is still going on, but at the same time the orders are also they have also flown in pretty well

triggers.label: Base business growth flat ex-export
triggers.quote: So that is what I said. That is where I'm saying that, we kept ourselves conservative.

guidance.quote: we are targeting revenue of approximately INR165 crores from the automotive business
around INR30 crores from the Agri segment
for FY28, we are aiming to scale overall revenues to nearly INR240 crores with agri business contributing close to INR50 crores
We continue to target healthy EBITDA margins in the range of 20% to 22%
along with PAT margins of around 10%

prior_guidance_check.quote: revenue for the year came in at INR113 crores, well within our guided range of INR100 crores to INR125 crores
It is INR190 crores that we have given for this year sir, INR195 crores.

red_flags.label: Base business flat ex-export order
red_flags.quote: So that is what I said. That is where I'm saying that, we kept ourselves conservative.

red_flags.label: Working capital elevated, receivables up
red_flags.quote: Working capital remained elevated during the year, primarily due to the start of the sale of our new U.S. OEM customer in March '26.

red_flags.label: Guidance on FY26 base reversal
red_flags.quote: So this entire increase in employee cost from first half to second half, which is IN R6 crores to roughly INR8 crores is largely driven by this export order?

evasions.quote: Himanshu, what we've just tried to do is to be conservative.
at this point I may not really be in a position to declare too much
those are very generic risks, which are there for every business, I would say.
